title: Cloudflare Status - Network performance issues in Ashburn, US (IAD)
text:

incident.name: Network performance issues in Ashburn, US (IAD)

incident_updates.body: Vendor has updated to say that their maintenance window will be extended till 13:00 UTC. Customers should continue to expect normal network behaviour and performance through the maintenance window.

Impact observed 06:33 - 06:41 UTC when we observe the vendor restoring the impacted capacity. We believe they temporarily affected all remaining capacity during the restoration and are following up with them. At this point all capacity has been restored and we are monitoring

We have identified the issue to be related to third-party circuit maintenance, have mitigated the impact that affected traffic, and customers should expect normal network behaviour and performance through the maintenance window. We will update when the maintenance is complete, expected at 10:00 GMT today (2026-10-13).
We have taken measures to address any impact and are closely monitoring the situation.
We are continuing to work on a fix for the issue.
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
Cloudflare is investigating issues with network performance in Ashburn, US (IAD). We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
